data.name: Azayiz
data.gender_notes: Azayiz is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Azayiz is derived from the Arabic root 'azaa' which means 'to be strong' or 'to be brave'. This name is often given to boys to reflect their strength, bravery, and victories in life. The name Azayiz carries the meaning “Strong, Brave, Victorious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Azayiz usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, brave, victorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Azayiz total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
